_doc: Kernel-scope conformance fixtures, proving positive coverage per CORE invariant (§7 of top-level-runtime-contract.md) and per in-kernel-scope support-matrix cell. Consumed by scripts/checks/conformance-matrix.js and counted by scripts/checks/contract-lint.js (fixture count nonzero).
_contract_lint_selftest_note: The 'contract-lint' directory (malformed, unresolvable-ref, missing-ed, core-waived-by-ed, trailer-not-terminal, malformed-heading, core-waived-with-correct-duplicate, register-block-removed, core-no-enforcer, duplicate-block-id, duplicate-register-row — each a .md fixture + a documenting .json descriptor) is contract-lint.js's OWN negative self-test corpus (consumed directly by contract-lint.test.js). It is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from the count above and from conformance-matrix.js's fixture walker: those inputs are contract-shaped documents fed to contract-lint itself, not {input,expect} kernel-conformance cases evaluated against role-binding.json/support-matrix.json. Counting or executing them as kernel-conformance fixtures would conflate contract-lint.js's self-test with conformance-matrix.js's matrix conformance.
_conformance_matrix_selftest_note: The 'conformance-matrix-selftest' directory (retention/bad-input-shape.json + role-binding/missing-required-field.json) is conformance-matrix.js's OWN negative self-test corpus (consumed directly by conformance-matrix.test.js) -- excluded from the count above via EXCLUDED_GATE_DIRS, mirroring the contract-lint self-test exclusion. Its fixtures are DELIBERATELY shape-malformed -- bad-input-shape.json has a non-object 'input'; missing-required-field.json has a valid-but-empty 'input:{}' that passes the input-shape check but is missing its gate's own required field(s), e.g. role-binding's 'actor_kind' -- to prove loadFixtures() fails closed (exit 2) rather than silently evaluating a malformed/underspecified case and reading a coincidental green.
_trust_boundary_seed_note: the 'trust-boundary' gate's evaluator (conformance-matrix.js GATE_EVALUATORS['trust-boundary']) only computes a BLOCK/PASS decision for the 'integrate_to_main' action -- ONE of CORE-2's four named powers (top-level-runtime-contract.md §1/§7 P7.2: capability grants, protected mutation, verification, integration-to-main). The other three powers are DEFINED by the contract but have no evaluator logic and always compute PASS against this seed. This is intentional scope, NOT a coverage gap: the CORE-2 invariant DEFINITION covers all four powers. Do not read core_coverage.CORE-2's single fixture as proof that capability-grants/protected-mutation/verification are themselves gated.

kernel_scope.candidate_immutability_note: This IN/OUT line is versioned (manifest_version) and CANDIDATE-IMMUTABLE — a candidate tree editing this manifest to narrow the IN list (so a difficult check no longer applies to it) is itself an untrusted change; contract-lint.js's self-host + conformance-matrix.js's coverage assertion are the interim guard.
